description: This file defines the interface 'DownstreamSender' which provides methods for sending messages to devices via Hono's southbound Telemetry and Event APIs. It specifies multiple overloaded 'send' methods supporting different payload types and additional properties, but contains no implementation.

classes.name: DownstreamSender
classes.description: A Java interface for sending messages to devices via Hono's telemetry and event APIs, supporting various payload formats and message properties.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message with a String payload to a specified device, returning a Future indicating the outcome.

methods.description: Sends a message with a byte array payload to a specified device, returning a Future indicating the outcome.

methods.description: Sends a message with properties and a String payload to a specified device, returning a Future indicating the outcome.
